purpose: One simple ventilation template per archetype configuration, read by epsm_core through BuildingArchetype.hvac_template. Airflow only: operating profiles supply occupied ventilation rates and envelope_performance supplies infiltration.
basis: EPSM assumption from typical Swedish practice: self-draught (S) in older buildings, mechanical exhaust (F) as the residential norm from the 1960s-1970s, supply/exhaust (FT) in 1960s-1970s premises, and heat recovery (FTX) in premises from the 1980s and in most new construction after the 2006 energy rules. Advanced renovation installs FTX; Standard renovation keeps the existing system. Not measured stock shares.

epsm.ventilation.S.note: Self-draught. 0.5 ACH is the BBR minimum 0.35 L/(s m2) at a 2.5 m room height; actual self-draught flow varies with weather.

epsm.ventilation.F.note: Mechanical exhaust without heat recovery; flow from the operating profile.

epsm.ventilation.FT.note: Mechanical supply and exhaust without heat recovery; flow from the operating profile.

epsm.ventilation.FTX_060.note: Early heat recovery (cross-flow plate or run-around coil), effectiveness 0.6.

epsm.ventilation.FTX_075.note: Typical rotary or counter-flow recovery 2006-2021, effectiveness 0.75.

epsm.ventilation.FTX_080.note: Current recovery for new construction and advanced renovation, effectiveness 0.8.
